Sign in with GitHub Copilot

Use your GitHub Copilot plan's models for Pi Durable, on Copilot's Responses API. Start, open GitHub's page and enter the code shown here; this page finishes once you approve.

Your risk

This signs in as the Copilot editor extension, with its GitHub client, as pi-ai does. GitHub's terms may not allow a Copilot plan's usage outside its own editors: that risk is yours, chosen knowingly. It needs a Copilot plan on your GitHub account, and lists Copilot's models on its Responses API (GPT, Grok), not its Claude or Gemini models, which take other APIs. GitHub offers this client no revocation, so signing out here does not end the grant: revoke it at github.com, under Settings, Applications.
